summary: Updated planner and autocheck prompts to reflect automatic system-level post-execution review: in PLAN_SYSTEM_PROMPT, standalone final steps now forbid run tests/verify/review and mention automatic code review; in REVIEW_INSTRUCTION approval criteria, added that plans do not need a final review/polish step because system-level review runs automatically. Verified successfully with pnpm lint, pnpm build, and pnpm vitest run src/goal/.
